causal_observation_limit.mechanism: The existing controlledInterception fixture delays delivery of the real Chromium rejection, and delays actual Performance.getMetrics dispatch on that same existing rejectionGate. The genuine command error, navigation, request cancellation and sample are not synthesized. This schedule is a local acceptance counterexample, not a claim about the hosted historical ordering.
causal_observation_limit.limit: The CDP error response exposes no Chromium execution timestamp. A post-command sample S and cancellation timestamp C with C <= S permit both failure-before-cancellation and cancellation-before-failure. Delaying delivery of the error and lifecycle events can leave the helper the same observations in both cases. A pre-command sample supplies a lower bound and instead rejects legitimate cancellation after that sample while the command is delayed (the two existing successive-navigation regressions remain). Neither bound is the missing failure instant.
causal_observation_limit.caller_result: All four relevant actual caller navigation-function cases pass in real Chromium: open authenticated native SSE stays usable until navigation, held interception completes before navigation, and a genuine live invalid id is reported before navigation even when rejection/sample delivery is held. These tests execute the exact caller function source with the existing loopback fixtures; they do not run the complete hosted CLI or prove that future renderer requests cannot race after settle returns.
causal_observation_limit.minimal_forward_proposal: Keep the existing caller drain/check candidate and the live-error negative control. Original Human/Ops must decide the minimal repair/observation contract for the unresolved interval: fail closed on ambiguous InvalidID and prevent controlled navigation/teardown while interception work is outstanding, or supply a causally ordered native failure observation through the existing transport. Merely renaming or moving a clock sample cannot supply that observation. No new coordination framework, auth/cookie system, broader diagnostics platform, retry/timeout inflation, or waiver of the full hosted gate is proposed. No decision is presumed here.
